llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Notifications screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Notifications screen is defined as NotificationsScreen and registered under the key 'Notifications' in the native stack navigator.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must model filter as an optional navigation param for the notifications screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: filter is typed as optional via route.params?.filter (params object itself is optional and filter within it is optional).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must default filter to all when the param is absent.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Nullish coalescing operator defaults filter to 'all' when the param is absent.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the normalized filter value in the screen UI.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The normalized filter value is rendered inside a Text component as 'Filter: {filter}'.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Stack is built with createNativeStackNavigator (static API object form), then wrapped with createStaticNavigation and rendered as <Navigation />.
